questions.prompt: True or False: Fish only swim in oceans.
questions.evidenceSnippet: Fish swim in lakes and creeks. Fish swim in deep blue seas or oceans.
questions.evidenceHighlight: Fish swim in lakes and creeks. Fish swim in deep blue seas or oceans.

choices: A bunch of fish swimming together
questions.evidenceSnippet: Fish can swim in a bunch, too. A bunch of fish is called a school.
questions.evidenceHighlight: A bunch of fish is called a school.

questions.prompt: True or False: Fish in a school do not help each other.
questions.evidenceSnippet: A school has lots of fish. They are a team. The fish help each other. They look for food together.

questions.prompt: What is the danger for a fish swimming alone?
questions.evidenceSnippet: It can be unsafe to swim alone. What is the chief reason? Danger! A fish can get snapped up!
questions.evidenceHighlight: A fish can get snapped up!

questions.prompt: True or False: Fish in a school look like one huge fish to scare big fish away.
questions.evidenceSnippet: The fish swim close together. Big fish will not mess with them because they look like one huge fish.
questions.evidenceHighlight: they look like one huge fish.

questions.prompt: Why does the big fish stay away from the school?
choices: It thinks the school is one huge fish.
It is scared of small fish.
questions.evidenceSnippet: This big fish wants to eat. But it stays away. The school looks like a huge fish that may eat him!
questions.evidenceHighlight: The school looks like a huge fish that may eat him!
